projects.title: HTTP exchange classifier
projects.completeScope: Classify the three real loopback exchanges as CSS GET, query GET and JSON POST, preserving method/path/status/media boundaries.

projects.title: Precise greeting resource
projects.completeScope: Implement exact GET greeting path recognition, percent decoding, trimming, blank/extra-segment rejection and a stable JSON envelope.

recap_pdf_consistency_policy: If the recap changes your form record, renew the manual declarations, export the updated PDF and reopen every page before submission. If review remains unfinished, agree a continuation and keep the record incomplete.
